prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photoreal 4:5 high-angle extreme close-up selfie of two adults, optionally matching separate approved adult identity references. The woman has long dark hair, soft rosy makeup, a brown tweed jacket over a covered cream top, and several plain unbranded gold bangles. The man looks softly toward camera while the woman rests her chin lightly on his shoulder; both appear relaxed and affectionate. Use harsh warm direct flash, 1990s disposable-camera grain, slight flash bloom, a warm neutral indoor wall, natural skin, and no text, logo, or watermark.
